title: Mariner 4 photographs a barren Mars

tellings.quote: Mariner for space probe photographed the planet up close in 1965 these photos revealed an inactive Planet barren and apparently lifeless

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recounts that in 1965 Mariner 4, an American space probe, flew past Mars and took the first close-up photos of the planet. According to Michels, those pictures showed a barren, inactive world that looked lifeless, which he uses as the starting point for asking whether Mars once held life.
